integrity: The proofs are analytic and self-contained. The supplied symbolic and rational checker is corroborative and finite; originality is a best-knowledge assessment, not a definitive priority certificate. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Optimal values for dimensions congruent to one or two modulo three are bounded, not determined exactly. Lower deficit constants are not claimed sharp; no higher-simplex or arbitrary-centroid theorem is asserted.
title: Modulo-three rigidity and a uniform residue gap for centered equilateral triangles in hypercubes
